description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Contract" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Project" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_QueryShops" sourceRef="SendTask_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_Shops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OffersFromShops" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PlaceOrders" sourceRef="SendTask_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Participant_Shops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstBatch" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderCheapest" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_Shops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderFastest" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_Shops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BatchFromShops" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Batch"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Project" name="Contract project needs parts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops for parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Offers" name="Receive offers (quantity, price, delivery time)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareOffers" name="Determine which shop has the right parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePartsList" name="Create list of parts to order from each shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OneShopSplit" name="One shop has enough parts?" default="Flow_07">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderOneShop" name="Order cheapest parts from one shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSeveralShops" name="Order cheapest parts from several shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderMerge" name="Order variant merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_PlaceOrders" name="Place orders with web shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_FirstBatch" name="First parts arrive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FirstBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BatchMerge" name="Wait for next batch">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_26</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Batch" name="Batch of parts arrives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Batch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateStock" name="Update stock of each part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockSplit" name="Check stock level per part" default="Flow_20">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ComplaintMail" name="Write complaint mail to friends about web shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder parts (fastest)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder parts (cheapest)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ContinueBuilding" name="Continue building">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_24</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompleteSplit" name="All parts received?" default="Flow_26">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_24</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_25</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_26</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BuildingFinished" name="Building finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_25</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Project" targetRef="SendTask_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="SendTask_QueryShops" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Offers" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Task_CreatePartsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CreatePartsList" targetRef="Gateway_OneShopSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OneShopSplit" targetRef="Task_OrderOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${oneShopSufficient == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OneShopSplit" targetRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_OrderOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderMerge" targetRef="SendTask_PlaceOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="SendTask_PlaceOrders" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_FirstBatch" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="Gateway_BatchMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_BatchMerge" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Batch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Batch" targetRef="Task_UpdateStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_UpdateStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="Stock is zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="UserTask_ComplaintMail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock == 0}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" name="Stock below 3" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="SendTask_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock > 0 && stock < 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" name="Stock below 5" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="SendTask_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock >= 3 && stock < 5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" name="Stock sufficient" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_ContinueBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="UserTask_ComplaintMail" targetRef="Gateway_BatchMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_BatchMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_BatchMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_ContinueBuilding" targetRef="Gateway_CompleteSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CompleteSplit" targetRef="EndEvent_BuildingFinished">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allPartsReceived == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CompleteSplit" targetRef="Gateway_BatchMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
